}}'''Hijacked Golems''' are the [[:Category:Hijacked Mobs|Hijacked Version]] of Iron Golems.
==''Spawning''==
* Spawned when an Iron Golem is hurt by a [[Gnat]] or a [[Lice]] when below 50% health.

==''Behavior''==
Hijacked Golems are melee tanks.
* Hijacked Golems attack through contact damage.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of a Hijacked Golem will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive]]. This does not go through walls.
* Hijacked Golems are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
* Hijacked Golems are able to dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* Hijacked Golems can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 3, with a 40 tick cooldown and a 2 Block range.

===''Weaknesses''===
* Hijacked Golems, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

==''Trivia''==

* The [[Gnat]] that infected the Iron Golem can be seen on its model, burrowed into what remains of its head.
** When the Hijacked Golem takes damage, its [[Gnat]] can be heard as well.
